# Kotlin codegen for map<K,V>: literal, index, and method dispatch via Android platform.

sngl generate --platform=android --lang=kotlin --out=out app.sngl
exists out/MainScreen.kt

# Map literal is emitted as mapOf(k to v, ...).
grep 'mapOf\(' out/MainScreen.kt
grep '"alice" to 10' out/MainScreen.kt
grep '"bob" to 20' out/MainScreen.kt

# map.length() dispatches to Kotlin Map .size property.
grep '\.size' out/MainScreen.kt

# map.get() dispatches to .getOrDefault().
grep '\.getOrDefault\(' out/MainScreen.kt

-- app.sngl --
import . "sngl:std"

output { kotlin { android } }

component main {
    var scores map<string, int> = {alice = 10, bob = 20}
    var size = 0
    button(text="count", @click {
        size = scores.length()
    })
    button(text="check", @click {
        size = scores.get("alice", 0)
    })
    text(value=string(size))
}
